name: Menaquinone-7
indication_description:
This capsule is indicated for the treatment and prevention of-
  • Osteoporosis
  • Coronary artery calcification
  • Rheumatoid arthritis
pharmacology_description: Menaquinone-7 is a fat soluble vitamin which is also known as vitamin K2. Menaquinone-7 is an especial key isomer of vitamin K2 that is produced using Bacillus subtilis. Menaquinone-7 is the active trans-isomer of natural vitamin K2 with the highest bioavailability and longest half-life in blood. This makes Menaquinone-7 also available for tissues outside the liver, namely bones, arteries and soft tissues. It is a powerful cofactor in transporting excess calcium out of the arteries and depositing it into the bones thus prevents hardening of arteries. Menaquinone-7 is very essential for healthy bone and artery.
dosage_description: Orally 1-2 capsules daily or as advised by the physician.
interaction_description: Menaquinone-7 may alter the effect of warfarin. Concomitant use with orlistat may decrease the absorption of Menaquinone-7.
contraindications_description: Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to Menaquinone-7. Use of Menaquinone-7 is contraindicated with warfarin.
side_effects_description: Generally well tolerated in recommended dose. From a large number of clinical trials using dosages in excess of 40 mg/day, there were no reports of side effects associated with any type of hypercoagulable state.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: Menaquinone-7 can be used during pregnancy. Use of Menaquinone-7 during pregnancy may help both mother and child in formation and maintaining proper bone health.
storage_conditions_description: Store at temperature below 30˚C, protect from light & moisture. Keep out of reach of children.
